clue.text: Spooner's ditched amusing chap, one with too much to say

definitions.text: one with too much to say

indicators.note: the Reverend Spooner's name signals swapping the opening sounds of two words

parts.note: to ditch something is to bin it, so ditched means binned
a wag is a joker, an amusing fellow

explanation.surface: Someone has got rid of a funny man who talked far too much.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the first sounds of BINNED WAG gives 'winned bag', which is said like the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A windbag is slang for a tediously long-winded talker.

clue.text: Nearly all the country is full of very loud chatter

indicators.note: being full of something means holding it inside, so one piece goes within the other
nearly all of the word means it loses its final letter

parts.note: Wales is a country of the United Kingdom
ff (fortissimo) is the musical marking for very loud

explanation.surface: Almost the whole nation is filled with deafening talk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'country' tempts as the definition, but the chatter comes at the end; Wales is the country being trimmed.
explanation.definitionFit: To waffle is to chatter at length without saying much, a British colloquialism.

clue.text: Number wanting good drinks, just small ones

parts.note: gins are drinks of the juniper spirit

explanation.surface: Someone short of a decent figure orders only modest drinks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wanting' just joins the pieces. The definition refers back to the drinks of the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Noggins are small measures of drink, usually a quarter of a pint, so the word means small drinks.

clue.text: Lad from shipbuilding centre, a street-seller?

indicators.note: this word only joins the neighbouring pieces: it says which one stands next to which in the answer

parts.note: Barrow-in-Furness in Cumbria is a famous English shipbuilding town
a lad is a boy

explanation.surface: A young man from a shipyard town turns out to sell goods in the street.
explanation.walkthrough: The town comes second in the clue but first in the answer; 'from' joins them.
explanation.definitionFit: A barrow boy is a British street trader who sells fruit or other goods from a handcart.

clue.text: Silly person needs words of encouragement

definitions.meaning: a fool or idiot, a buffoon
the phrase urging someone to continue or try something

explanation.surface: A fool needs someone to cheer them on.
explanation.definitionFit: A goon is a foolish person, while the two-word phrase is spoken to urge someone on.

clue.text: Score 100 sitting next to creep maybe in school

indicators.note: in places the 100-and-creep pair inside the school abbreviation

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
a rat is one example of a contemptible creep

explanation.surface: A century is scored by a pupil sitting beside the class sneak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Score' reads as a number in a sporting surface beside '100'; here it is a verb, to mark a line on something.
explanation.definitionFit: To score a surface is to mark it with a line, which is what scratching does.

clue.text: No objection, but America's upset over another country closing its own borders

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits over the next
in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the word is read bottom to top

parts.note: US is short for the United States of America

indicators.note: closing round something means enclosing it

parts.note: France is a country
the borders of the word France are its first and last letters, F and E

explanation.surface: A political complaint that America is cross with another nation that has shut its frontiers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns US to SU. The definition is a noun phrase: sufferance is tolerance arising from no one objecting.
explanation.definitionFit: Sufferance is tolerance or tacit permission, being allowed something because no one objects.

clue.text: Way to keep performing old piece of music

indicators.note: to keep something is to hold it inside

parts.note: Rd is the abbreviation for road, a way
a performer is on, onstage

explanation.surface: A method of staying on stage playing an ancient tune.
explanation.definitionFit: A rondo is a musical form or movement in which a principal theme keeps returning.

clue.text: Drums giving the enemy endless alarm — about to run off

indicators.note: without its end, the word loses its last letter

parts.note: time is called 'the enemy' in the saying 'time is the enemy'

indicators.note: to run off is to leave, so the letters for about are taken away

parts.note: panic is sudden alarm
c (circa) is Latin for about

explanation.surface: Drums sounding the alarm, endlessly, as the enemy approaches and people flee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' cuts TIME to TIM; 'to run off' removes C from PANIC, leaving PANI.
explanation.definitionFit: Timpani are kettledrums, the large tuned drums of an orchestra.

clue.text: Tradition allows male no place in sanctuary

indicators.note: giving something no place in a word means taking it out

parts.note: a hermitage is a secluded retreat, a sanctuary

explanation.surface: Custom forbids men from entering a holy refuge.
explanation.definitionFit: A heritage is something handed down from the past, such as traditions and customs.

clue.text: Someone laughed at number unfriendly towards peacekeepers?

parts.note: a figure is a number
being off with someone is being cool and unfriendly
the UN (United Nations) sends peacekeeping forces

explanation.surface: Someone who is hostile to United Nations troops.
explanation.definitionFit: A figure of fun is a person who is ridiculed, an object of mockery.

clue.text: Blight when spring growth starts?

definitions.meaning: to blight something is to spoil or damage it
the abbreviation of the month at the start of spring in the northern hemisphere

explanation.surface: Disease strikes just as the spring shoots appear.
explanation.definitionFit: To mar is to spoil or blight, and Mar is the short form of the month that spring begins in.

clue.text: Provided learner with excellent tutor maybe

parts.note: L is for learner, as on British learner-driver plates
A1 means first-rate, written AI in crosswords
a don is a university teacher, for example a tutor

explanation.surface: A student was given a first-rate teacher.
explanation.definitionFit: To lay something on is to provide or supply it, as with a buffet laid on for guests.

clue.text: Ringing about member of family needing worker?

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a son is one member of a family
an ant is the standard crossword worker

explanation.surface: A phone call about a relative who needs a job.
explanation.definitionFit: Resonant describes a sound that echoes or rings deeply.

clue.text: Supporting worker not keeping up with schedule

parts.note: to be behind someone is to support them
a hand is a manual worker, as in farmhand

explanation.surface: A backup labourer is falling behind the timetable.
explanation.definitionFit: Behindhand means late or in arrears, failing to keep pace with what is due.

clue.text: Activity to get bears showing aggression

parts.note: rattling, an activity of shaking things up, applied to the word bears jumbles its letters into a sword

explanation.surface: What you do to provoke the bears into turning aggressive.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as wordplay: RATTLING (shaking up) the word BEARS gives SABRE, so the answer is what gets SABRE from 'bears'.
explanation.definitionFit: Sabre-rattling is the display of military threat or belligerent posturing.

clue.text: Those people fuss about mike ignoring fringe characters in musical drama

indicators.note: about means around, so the first pieces surround the inner letters

parts.note: them means those people
ado is fuss or bother

indicators.note: ignoring the outside letters leaves only the middle of the word

explanation.surface: A group make a fuss over a microphone, cutting the edges off characters in a show.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mike' is the radio-alphabet word for M, but here it is just fodder trimmed to its middle letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The Mikado is the Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera, a musical drama.

clue.text: Perhaps Norma and Edward ran

parts.note: Norma is an opera by Bellini, so it is an example of an opera
Ted is a short form of Edward

explanation.surface: Two people, Norma and Edward, made a dash for it.
explanation.walkthrough: Norma looks like a woman's name; it is Bellini's opera.
explanation.definitionFit: To operate a business or machine is to run it, so operated means ran.

clue.text: Mean types who may be had up for sexual harassment?

definitions.meaning: stingy people who hate spending money

definitions.text: who may be had up for sexual harassment?
definitions.meaning: read literally, people who pinch a woman named Penny could face charges for groping

explanation.surface: Misers who could be charged with groping.
explanation.definitionFit: Penny-pinchers are miserly people who are reluctant to spend anything.

clue.text: Chinese city with old female ruler?

parts.note: nan is a British word for grandmother, an elderly woman
a king is a ruler

explanation.surface: A Chinese city governed by an elderly queen.
explanation.walkthrough: NAN is everyday British for grandma.
explanation.definitionFit: Nanking (now Nanjing) is a major city in eastern China.

clue.text: One collects hard pebbles

indicators.note: collecting something means taking it in, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: single means one
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A lone person gathers hard stones on the beach.
explanation.definitionFit: Shingle is a mass of small rounded stones, as found on beaches.

clue.text: Star material? It's in the blood

definitions.meaning: the ionised state of matter that makes up stars
the pale fluid part of blood that carries the cells

explanation.surface: Is the stuff of celebrities something you are born with?
explanation.definitionFit: Plasma is both the ionised gas of stars and the liquid component of blood.

clue.text: Call team from position near competition arena

parts.note: to ring is to call on the telephone
a side is a team

explanation.surface: Phoning a team to cover a fight from the best seats.
explanation.definitionFit: The ringside is the area right beside a boxing ring or arena.

clue.text: Start of section, say, with no musical sign that should be there?

definitions.text: musical sign that should be there?

indicators.note: the start of a word is its first letter

parts.note: e.g. means for example, say
taken as written

explanation.surface: A composer finds a section begins without the mark it ought to have.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition plays on 'dal segno', the instruction to go back to the sign: it marks where the music should return to.
explanation.definitionFit: Segno is the Italian word for sign, the mark showing where a repeat begins in a score.

clue.text: Ornament I brought in last

indicators.note: bringing something in places it inside

parts.note: final means last

explanation.surface: An ornament I bought was the final one.
explanation.definitionFit: A finial is a decorative knob or ornament on top of a spire, gable or post.

clue.text: Jack's son, a bounder

definitions.note: read as 'Jack is', the definition being Jack, the fish

parts.note: a cad is a bounder, an ungentlemanly man

explanation.surface: A man's boy turns out to be a scoundrel.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack looks like a name; it is the fish called jack or horse mackerel, and the 's is 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: The scad, or horse mackerel, is a fish of the jack family.

clue.text: In France, you and I meet New Zealand native

parts.note: tu is the familiar French word for you
tu is the familiar French word for you

explanation.surface: A French meeting between you and me and a New Zealander.
explanation.walkthrough: The tui is a New Zealand songbird.
explanation.definitionFit: The tui is a honeyeater bird found only in New Zealand.

clue.text: Actions in cars, say, one of which may produce rage?

definitions.meaning: shifting from one ratio to another while driving

definitions.text: one of which may produce rage?
definitions.meaning: read literally, a change to the word gear can rearrange it into rage

explanation.surface: Shifting gear can make a driver angry.
explanation.definitionFit: Gear changes are the shifts between gears made when driving, and changing gear's letters gives rage.

clue.text: Be virtuous, protecting wife's tree

indicators.note: protecting something means surrounding it, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: to do good is to act virtuously
W is the abbreviation for wife

explanation.surface: Behaving well by guarding a wife's tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogwood is a flowering shrub or small tree of the genus Cornus.

clue.text: Orders a new insectivorous plant

indicators.note: new means remade, so the letters are formed afresh

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gardener orders another insect-eating plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Drosera is the botanical genus of sundews, carnivorous plants that trap insects.
